title: International calendar
body:
I live in Panama but travel often. Before going to a country, i like to book meetings in advance. The problem is the time difference and the mess with me booking meetings in Panama time and they getting them in NYC, Madrid or else time. 

I will like to book a meeting on the local time of a country. This will me “my time” as soon as i arrive in that country but for the time i’m somewhere else, there is a time difference.

Example, i’m traveling to Costa Rica next week and i’m booking my meetings. I will like to put “2pm costa rica time” while i’m booking it. Panama is - hour ahead of CR. So in stead to booking the meeting 3pm Panama time, so it becomes 2pm ones i arrive CR, making sure i get all the meetings booked in the local time without any calculations.
